subject: Standby pledge activation — Helio Labs (DL-2026-387)

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 09:15:00 -0700
Subject: Standby pledge activation - Helio Labs (Deal DL-2026-387)

Team —

Quick heads-up: Helio is asking for an internal confirmation that we can stand-by the equivalent of a 32x A100 pool (or the quantized + sharded equivalent) to meet their Q3 ramp target. Sales asked for a "soft hold" to be in place through the contracting window (approx 6 weeks) while they finalize PO/terms.

Can infra/ops confirm the following by EOD?
- Expected available GPU-equivalent capacity in US-west region for July 1 start (node slots / estimated TFLOPs)
- Any fragility windows (maintenance, known migrations) in late June — early July
- Ops-side impact of a 6-week soft hold vs firm commit (oversubscribe risk)

I attached the sizing the AE sent (requested_sizing_estimate.xlsx) with the Helio target loads. If we can’t match the exact SKU mix, please propose an equivalent configuration and estimated perf delta.

Ben
Ben Carter
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.ai

Attachments: requested_sizing_estimate.xlsx (spreadsheet stub)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Standby pledge activation - Helio Labs (Deal DL-2026-387)

On Mon, May 10, 2027 at 09:15 AM Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Team —
> 
> Quick heads-up: Helio is asking for an internal confirmation that we can stand-by the equivalent of a 32x A100 pool ...

Ben / Sofia —

Checked with pool controller and capacity planning. Short summary: we can provide an equivalent capacity profile but with these caveats:
- US-west hot-pool currently has the equivalent of ~24 full A100 slots unconstrained over July. We can create an additional 8-slot capability by combining 16x quantized T4-equivalents + prewarmed KV caches (expected ~0.85x perf vs native A100 on our 1K-token workloads).
- If Helio needs strict A100-class throughput for sustained bursts, we’d need to allocate from dedicated reserved nodes (impact: estimated 12% higher monthly cost).
- There is a rolling maintenance window planned 2027-06-24 — 2027-06-26 for kernel updates on two rack clusters in us-west-2; those racks are not in the hot-pool but could reduce headroom by 6–9% if incidents occur.

Operational ask: we can mark a 6-week soft hold in the scheduler (no hard pin) and flag the allocation to prewarm KV caches and warm-start the model shards. Soft hold semantics:
- Hold prevents autoscaler from reassigning those cache-primed slots unless higher-priority enterprise commitments (SLA tier 1) need immediate capacity.
- Hold state will be visible to sales and ops dashboards, and can be released with 48-hr notice.

I attached the current pool snapshot (pool_snapshot_20270510.csv) and a quick delta table (internal notes below). Recommend approving soft hold for up to 6 weeks, with a checkpoint at week 3 to reassess given June maintenance.

Marcus
Marcus Lin
Head of Serving Ops, Redwood Inference
marcus@redwood.ai

Attachments: pool_snapshot_20270510.csv (CSV stub)

From: Sofia Ivanova <sofia@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Grant <alex@helio.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Jordan Blake <jordan@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 10 May 2027 13:30:00 -0700
Subject: Standby pledge activation — Helio Labs (DL-2026-387)

Alex —

Looping you in with internal capacity notes so you have the operational view while procurement finalizes the PO. Below is the current ask and the internal plan we can put in place as a soft hold while contracting completes.

Summary for Helio:
- Redwood can provision an equivalent 32-slot A100 profile for the requested July start by combining 24 native A100 slots + 8 quantized/backup slots. Estimated performance is ~85–90% of raw A100 on your expected prompts; we’ll include model-specific perf tuning during warm-up.
- We will place a 6-week soft hold on that capacity (no billing changes until contract) to ensure prewarming. The hold can be released with 48 hours notice.
- Notable risk: minor maintenance window 2027-06-24 — 2027-06-26 could temporarily reduce headroom; we’ll do a runbook check in week 3.

Next steps (proposed):
1) Helio confirms target start date (you listed July 1) and any absolute constraints on perf SLA.
2) Procurement sends PO/term sheet (Ben) — once we have the PO we’ll convert the soft hold to a billing-enabled reserved allocation per DL-2026-387.
3) Ops (Marcus) will prewarm caches and run a short canary on July 1 for ~8 hours to validate latency profile.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-min runbook walkthrough later this week.

Thanks,
Sofia Ivanova
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference
sofia@redwood.ai
